metadata.title: Nebula v2
metadata.description: Native code from the Petari decompilation, every language, four platforms, more controllers, mods and 35 achievements.

page.paragraph_2: What is new in Nebula v2.

overview.paragraph_1: Nebula v2 runs Super Mario Galaxy as native code built from SMGCommunity’s Petari decompilation.
overview.paragraph_2: Setup reads your disc image and prepares the game files. It no longer compiles the game.
overview.paragraph_3: Coming soon. Gameplay footage will be added here.

comforts.item_1: All US, PAL and JP languages, each through its own language’s ISO.
comforts.item_2: Windows (Direct3D 12 and 11), Linux and Android (Vulkan), and macOS (Metal).
comforts.item_3: A home screen with Play, Settings, Benchmark and Quit, and in-app updates.
comforts.item_4: DLSS, FSR 1, FSR 3, XeSS, SGSR 2 and MetalFX upscaling.
comforts.item_5: MSAA, SMAA and FXAA anti-aliasing, SSAO and GTAO ambient occlusion, enhanced lighting and HDR.
comforts.item_6: Interpolation above 60 Hz, with DLSS Frame Generation and FSR frame generation on supported GPUs.
comforts.item_7: PlayStation, Steam, Steam Deck and generic controllers, with gyro pointing on controllers with motion sensors.
comforts.item_9: Dialogue speed up to Instant, including Rosalina’s storybook.
comforts.item_10: Separate volumes for music, effects, voices, ambience, cutscenes and the Wii Remote speaker.
comforts.item_11: Mods as .luma files made with LumaLink, and direct import of Riivolution and Dolphin texture packs.
comforts.item_13: Discord status with your current galaxy and mission.
comforts.item_14: Save import and export in the game, from a Wii, Dolphin or the Switch release.
comforts.item_15: Menus in all 14 of the game’s languages, and error codes with a saved report.
comforts.item_16: Ray-traced lighting is being worked on and will come in a very soon release.

achievements.paragraph_1: After the first Grand Star, a Luma in the Comet Observatory shows your achievements and play statistics.
achievements.paragraph_2: Grab your very first Power Star.
achievements.paragraph_3: Feed a Hungry Luma until it transforms into a new galaxy.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
